images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: generic food illustration for an age-respectful picture communication board. Primary request: a clear photorealistic illustration of one plain old-fashioned cake ring doughnut, matte golden-brown surface with naturally cracked cake texture and a visible center hole; no glaze, no powdered sugar, no icing. Single fully visible item isolated on a pure white background. Three-quarter overhead view, softly and evenly lit, centered, ample clean white space all around the item. Natural accurate food colors, realistic appetizing texture, only a delicate contact shadow. Square image. No text, labels, logos, packaging, plates, utensils, napkins, hands, people, faces, extra food, or venue-identifying details. This is a generic illustrative food, not any real brand's actual product.
images.review: Single fully visible food item, natural recognizable food colors, plain white background, no text/logo/faces; visually reviewed.

font_note: PDF embeds locally installed Liberation Sans regular/bold and Liberation Serif regular, with a DejaVu fallback in the reproducible generator.

validation.visual_review: Both latest PDF-rendered PNGs inspected with embedded fonts. No clipped labels or overlapping elements. Four generated food illustrations individually reviewed.
validation.functional_checks: Focused DOM behavior checks passed: no automatic speech; explicit speech only; local voice preference; cancellation/error/unavailable-browser fallback; single selection; hide/unhide food; hidden choice clears; zero-food fallback; persistent refusal/support choices; Clear focus; explicit print. HTML references exist, IDs unique, all buttons type=button, all images have alt.
validation.browser_limit: No local browser binary available. Phone layout and actual device speech await root live-site browser QA; no full accessibility audit claimed.
